title: EFC — Light Speed as a Regulator of Energy Flow in the Universe
abstract: Proposes an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) framework in which the invariant speed of light c regulates energy flow, spacetime distortion, and entropy across three interacting components: Main Clusters, Small Clusters, and the Halo. The paper outlines qualitative parameter ranges for energy flow and gravitational lensing in each component and reports consistency with Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) correlations between redshift, lensing, and energy-flow gradients toward the halo.
